title: Plans to visit Floyd Jackson, the multi-instrumentalist
summary: Joseph wants to take the interviewers to see Floyd Jackson, who played trumpet, organ, piano, trombone, bass violin and sousaphone.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: So if I have time, I'll take you around some of them people sometime.
Someday we'd like to get up there, yeah.
I'll let you. I like to see Floyd. That's what I want you to see.
Well, we'll take a run up there. I have a...

That's a man who played everything. Floyd Jackson. He ought to be about... I'll be close to 17. I got 65, something like that. Man played trumpet, organ, piano, sliding trombone, bass violin, bass sousaphone. Play all that. He was a bitch on the sousa and tubo. You know that tubo player?
